settings.title: Our Story
settings.subtitle: Redefining the Diamond Industry, One Brilliant Choice at a Time
settings.intro:
We didn’t set out to create another jewelry brand.

We set out to challenge an industry.
settings.story:
For decades, buying a diamond meant accepting a system built on tradition, limited transparency, and unnecessary compromise. Meanwhile, a new generation emerged—one that values innovation as much as craftsmanship, and conscious choices as much as timeless design.

Dinova was built for them.

Founded by Egyptian innovators, gemologists, and entrepreneurs, Dinova introduces a new chapter of fine jewelry through IGI-certified lab-grown diamonds and exceptional craftsmanship in 18K gold.

We’re not simply bringing lab-grown diamonds to Egypt.

We’re redefining luxury for a generation that expects more.

Diamonds. Reimagined.

settings.title: Innovation
settings.text: We embrace the technology that allows us to create brilliance, not just find it.

settings.title: Transparency
settings.text: From our IGI certifications to our educational hub, we empower you with knowledge. A Dinova customer is an educated customer.

settings.title: Modern Egyptian Luxury
settings.text: We are proudly based in Cairo, blending global standards with a deep understanding of what our market desires: quality, value, and authenticity.
